dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: Hey, you, blondie! Perfect timing — this punk's cruisin' for a bruisin'. Lend a hand, and I'll make sure you get your cut.

dialogues.speaker: Hoyka
dialogues.text: #What are you playing at? Calling in backup cause you know you can't win? Fine, two can play at that game! Listen here, {M#mate}{F#lass}, help me take this guy down, and I'll split the Mora with you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Wait, we're just passing by...

dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: Huh... Let 'em bounce. Them water snakes don't know their place, tryna slither up on our turf.

dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: Thanks for the help. Once my boys drop this "Mademoiselle Belleville" off in Nasha Town, you'll get your cut.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right, the payment— Wait... Mademoiselle? Are you human traffickers?!

dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: Don't get the wrong idea, lil' girl. We don't touch kidnappings.

dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: "Mademoiselle Belleville" is the name of this hunk of metal. Shipped all the way from the Fleuve Cendre, it wasn't easy getting it here. If it got snatched, we'd be ruined.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, a Fontainian clockwork meka? Wow, Fontaine tech really is something else. Imagine still working after being transported all this way...

dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: Are you taking the Fonta? This thing's power system was ripped out ages ago. There's no way it's—

dialogues.speaker: Mademoiselle Belleville
dialogues.text: WARNING. Startup mode <color=#FF5E41FF>ANOMALOUS</color>. Energy module <color=#FF5E41FF>ABx5F02&#5E38NORMAL</color>. Verification failed.

dialogues.speaker: Mademoiselle Belleville
dialogues.text: Verification failed. <color=#FF5E41FF>Verification failed</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Verification failed</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate Exterminate Exterminate</color>—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Eek! {NICKNAME}, watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Hoyka
dialogues.text: Ha! That's the end of that — foreign nutjob spouting nonsense, rambling on about liquidating my crew. Not doing much liquidating now he's frozen solid, 'ey?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Now we've saved Nasha Town from being flooded with contraband! Oh, and hey, don't forget our reward!

dialogues.speaker: Hoyka
dialogues.text: Hmph, don't get ahead of yourselves — I gotta check the goods first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, check... the g—goods?

dialogues.speaker: Hoyka
dialogues.text: Of course! If something's wrong with the goods then we don't get nothin' — and your cut of nothin', is nothin'.

dialogues.speaker: Hoyka
dialogues.text: Tch... Look at these scratches. Rust, too! The Fleuve Cendre's getting real sloppy these days...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Isn't that a Fontainian clockwork meka? Wow, Fontaine tech really is something else. Imagine still working after being transported all this way...

dialogues.speaker: Hoyka
dialogues.text: Still working? Give it a rest! The power system in this thing should've been ripped out ages ago. There's no way it's—

dialogues.speaker: Mademoiselle Belleville
dialogues.text: WARNING. Startup mode <color=#FF5E41FF>ANOMALOUS</color>. Energy module <color=#FF5E41FF>ABx5F02&#5E38NORMAL</color>. Verification failed.

dialogues.speaker: Mademoiselle Belleville
dialogues.text: Verification failed. <color=#FF5E41FF>Verification failed</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Verification failed</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate Exterminate Exterminate</color>—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Eek! {NICKNAME}, watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, we showed them! Can you believe those Treasure Hoarders thought we'd play muscle for them?

choices.text: Justice always prevails in the end!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Totally! Though now we've sent them packing, Paimon's a little bit curious as to what exactly is in there that they were fighting for?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Isn't that a Fontainian clockwork meka? Wow, Fontaine tech really is something else. Imagine still working after being transported all this way...

response.speaker: Mademoiselle Belleville
response.text: WARNING. Startup mode <color=#FF5E41FF>ANOMALOUS</color>. Energy module <color=#FF5E41FF>ABx5F02&#5E38NORMAL</color>. Verification failed.

response.speaker: Mademoiselle Belleville
response.text: Verification failed. <color=#FF5E41FF>Verification failed</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Verification failed</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate</color>. <color=#FF5E41FF>Exterminate Exterminate Exterminate</color>—

choices.text: Haha, now it's mine and mine alone!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Why share it when we could totally keep it for oursel— wait, no! What are you saying!? We're righteous adventurers... right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Though now we've sent them packing, Paimon's a little bit curious as to what exactly is in there that they were fighting for?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Help Basu) You can't just go around taking people's stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: Haha, I knew you were a smart one. Let's trash these clowns!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Help Hoyka) Are they transporting contraband?

dialogues.speaker: Hoyka
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh... right... yeah! That crate's totally packed with illegal contraband — we can't let them haul it to Nasha Town!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Treasure Hoarders, is it? No worries, I'll handle you all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: T—Too right! We're honorable adventurers, there's no way we're helping any nasty Treasure Hoarders! If someone's up to no good, we're gonna put a stop to them!

dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: You crusty two-bit hustler! Tryin' to muscle in on our route? Mess up the Boss's shipment to Nasha Town, and you'll have to liquidate your whole crew just to cover what you owe!

dialogues.speaker: Hoyka
dialogues.text: Pfft, liquidate? I'll freeze your whole crew solid and then walk off with the goods!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, it looks they're going to start a fight over there!

dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: Ugh... Lousy luck today, but whatever – in this line of work, one more body ain't no trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... At least that's finally over...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It doesn't look like we'll be getting a reward now... But hey, at least we shut it down when we did. If anyone had gotten hurt... Umm, it is shut down this time, right?
